rawFindings.title: Incorrect routing when multiple handlers defined for same path and method
rawFindings.explanation: The original code uses this._router.route(path) directly for route handling in app[method], which creates a new route instance each time, potentially causing multiple routes for the same path instead of reusing a single base route. This breaks expected behavior of multiple app.VERB calls for the same path, leading to unexpected route handling.
rawFindings.suggestion: Change to use a cached base route using a _baseRoutes map and a helper _baseRoute method to ensure a single route instance for the same path and method, as introduced in the patch by adding _baseRoutes property and _baseRoute method, and replacing this._router.route(path) with this._baseRoute(path).

rawFindings.title: app.all method does not reuse base route for same path
rawFindings.explanation: Similar to the app[method] issue, app.all creates new route instance each time by calling this._router.route(path) directly, instead of using a cached base route. This can cause multiple routes to be registered for the same path in app.all, breaking proper routing behavior.
rawFindings.suggestion: Use the new _baseRoute(path) method in app.all to reuse existing routes for the same path instead of creating new route instances each time.
